authority.inventory_role: Named courses Jordan, Arnon, upper Jabbok, Zered, Kanah and River of Egypt remain sector observations; Unrecorded does not authorize drawing.

policy: Modern NE lines are physical proxies, never proof of ancient courses or territorial edges. Alternatives are capped at Medium. Partial or missing courses stay recorded and undrawn; no frame expansion.

requirements.name: Jordan
requirements.role: Both; Num 13:29; Deut 3:17; Josh 13:23, 27; 19:34. NE 229, 138 river vertices and 23 lake-centerline vertices in five source parts. Upper-Jordan reading primary at Josh 19:34; Havoth-jair and town-Judah readings remain golden-spec alternatives.

requirements.name: Nile
requirements.role: Both, Egypt/Kush physical anchor; Exod 1–14; Gen 47:11. NE 4, with Rosetta 19 and Damietta 20. Modern branches do not locate the ancient Pelusiac branch. Outside the Canaan admission window.

requirements.name: Euphrates
requirements.role: 1446, Egyptian campaign/upper Mesopotamia; golden 1446 §4. NE 62 (Euphrates), 65 (Firat), 69 (Al Furat). Outside the Canaan admission window.

requirements.name: Tigris
requirements.role: 1446, Assyria/upper Mesopotamia; golden 1446 §4. NE 135 (Tigris), 120 (Dicle). Outside the Canaan admission window.

requirements.name: Orontes
requirements.role: Both, Kadesh/Asian sphere; golden 1446 §4, 1399 §4.8. No Orontes course in the vendored NE file.

requirements.name: Eleutheros
requirements.role: 1446, Asian sphere's changing northern reach; golden 1446 §4. Nahr el-Kabir identification; no NE course. This campaign limit never justifies a fixed state boundary.

requirements.name: Khabur
requirements.role: 1446, Mitanni's Khabur triangle; golden 1446 §4. No NE course.

requirements.name: Arnon
requirements.role: Both; Num 21:13, 26; Judg 11:18. Wadi Mujib identification. No NE course; the 1399 border remains a recorded geometry gap, not a straight chord.

requirements.name: Jabbok
requirements.role: Both; Num 21:24; Deut 3:16; Josh 12:2. Upper Wadi Zarqa identification. No NE course; Gad reaching into Ammon itself remains the golden-spec alternative.

requirements.name: Zered
requirements.role: Both; Num 21:11–12; Deut 2:8–14. Wadi el-Hasa identification; border role interpreted, Low. No NE course; Scripture does not call it Moab's boundary.

requirements.name: Kanah
requirements.role: 1399; Josh 16:8; 17:9–10. Wadi Qana identification for the brook, not the separate city Qana of Josh 19:28. No NE course.

requirements.name: Kishon
requirements.role: 1399; Josh 19:11's river before Jokneam is a tributary; Shihor-libnath chosen at its mouth, golden 1399 §5.4. No NE course.

requirements.name: Yarkon
requirements.role: 1399; Josh 19:46 Me-jarkon, golden 1399 §5.4. No NE course.

requirements.name: Yarmuk
requirements.role: 1399 identification discussion for Zaphon, golden 1399 §5.4; the PEF's conflation of Amathus and el-Hammeh is recorded, not a new chosen river boundary. No NE course.

requirements.name: Belus
requirements.role: 1399 alternative Shihor-libnath identification: PEF Nahr Na'amein (Handbook pp. 267–268), golden 1399 §5.4. Alternative remains recorded, capped below High; no NE course.

requirements.name: Shihor-libnath
requirements.role: 1399; Josh 19:26. Kishon mouth primary, Belus alternative (§5.4); no separately located NE course. A name match is not scriptural site derivation.
alternatives: Belus: retained identification alternative, capped at Medium.

requirements.name: River of Egypt
requirements.role: 1399; Josh 15:4, 47. Wadi el-Arish primary; Pelusiac Nile/Sihor alternative (Josh 13:3; 1 Chr 13:5), golden §6. No NE Wadi el-Arish course.
alternatives: Pelusiac Nile/Sihor: retained alternative, no ancient branch course.

requirements.name: Pelusiac Nile
requirements.role: 1399 River-of-Egypt alternative; golden §6. No permitted ancient branch course in the modern NE file; Rosetta/Damietta are not substitutions.

requirements.name: Diyala
requirements.role: 1446 §4.5, lines 214/217: Kassite alluvial reach and Qutian-Lullubian headwaters; no vendored NE course.

requirements.name: Yellow River
requirements.role: 1446 §4.7, line 236: Shang core in central Henan. Selected NE Huang main drainage; modern proxy, not a Shang border.

requirements.name: Gan
requirements.role: 1446 §4.7, line 238 and evidence row 63: Wucheng/Jiangxi setting; modern NE Gan proxy, no cultural perimeter.

requirements.name: Gadar
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 73, line 496: Hasanlu valley context; no vendored NE course.

requirements.name: Nam
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 76, line 499: Daepyeong/Jinju setting; NE Namhan 555 lies in a different Korean drainage and is not selected.
alternatives: Namhan NE 555 rejected: source lies at 36.95–37.58 N, unlike the Jinju/Daepyeong requirement.

requirements.name: Sangha
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 82, line 508: later rainforest migration context, not a border or a presence ground at 1446; modern proxy only.

requirements.name: Volga
requirements.role: 1446 §4.9, line 244 and evidence row 78: Srubnaya/Samara valley distribution context, not sovereignty.

requirements.name: Dnieper
requirements.role: 1446 §4.9, line 244 and §4.11, line 272: Srubnaya and Sabatinovka context. NE Dnepre 121 preserves only a headwater reach; lower reaches remain Unlocated.

requirements.name: Southern Buh
requirements.role: 1446 §4.11, line 272 and evidence row 85: Sabatinovka context. Selected NE Southern Bug 670 in Ukraine; NE Buh 491 in China and Bug 732 on the Polish border are rejected identities.

requirements.name: Yangtze
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 63, line 481: source-title context for lower Yangtze/Wucheng discussion, not a territorial course.

requirements.name: Indus
requirements.role: 1446 evidence rows 64–66, lines 482/484/485: Late Harappan regional sequence context, not a culture-area perimeter.

requirements.name: Coatzacoalcos
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 90, line 519: San Lorenzo basin context, not an Olmec border.

requirements.name: Mississippi
requirements.role: 1446 §4.13, line 287 and evidence row 91: Poverty Point lower-valley context, not a polity border.

requirements.name: Tungabhadra
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 72, line 492: Hallur setting in the upper drainage; no cultural perimeter.

requirements.name: Cagayan
requirements.role: 1446 evidence row 79, line 502: Nagsabaran valley context; modern NE proxy only.

requirements.name: Po
requirements.role: 1446 §4.11, line 274: Terramare central-plain context; no cultural perimeter.
